# observability (observability.origincloudapis.eu)

Guide: <https://docs.origincloud.eu/docs/observability/index.html.md>

- **MetricService**: The metrics the platform collects for a project's compute instances, volumes and network interfaces: CPU time, network traffic, and volume reads and writes.

origincloudhq/origincloud 0.18.0 has no resource or data source of this service.

## Other actions

These methods aren't a resource's create, read, update or delete. Where an argument of a resource above sets the same thing (a resource's `protected`, say), change the argument; otherwise the provider doesn't manage the action: run it with the CLI, outside of Terraform, when the user asks for it.

- `QueryTimeSeries` (`origin observability query-time-series`): Returns a resource's time series for the metrics asked, one per metric, in the order asked.
